يغتنموا (form VIII)
# يَغْتَنِمُوا (yaḡtanimū) /jaɣ.ta.ni.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# يُغْتَنَمُوا (yuḡtanamū) /juɣ.ta.na.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
